newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-National Mutual joins Melbourne airport bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-National Mutual joins Melbourne airport bid.

text.p: National Mutual Funds Management (NMFM) said on Monday it would join a consortium bidding to acquire Melbourne Airport from the Australian government.
NMFM, a wholly-owned unit of National Mutual Holdings Ltd, said it was joining the Victoria Airports Ltd Consortium to bid for the airport.
Other members of the consortium include Manchester Airport Plc, SERCO Aviation Services Pty Ltd, Macquarie Bank Ltd and privately held Pratt Industries.
"We believe Melbourne Airport could be an attractive investment for our clients, while also contributing to the prosperity of Victoria," NMFM managing director Sam Kavourakis said in a statement.
NMFM said it was bidding on behalf of the National Mutual Life Association of Australasia Ltd and some other interested clients.
NMFM is Australia's fourth-largest funds manager with more than A$23 billion in funds under management.
The statement came the day before its parent will list on the Australian and New Zealand stock exchanges.
Melbourne is one of several Australian airports that the government is leasing to private operators in a A$2 billion privatisation programme.
